name: Demons of the Hearth
source:
Step into the shoes of a weakened and defeated demon lord; eager to reclaim your throne and secure a promising future for a bitter and chaotic race. This leads you to the city of Sanctus, a boiling pot of passion, violence, and treachery.

You must use every tool at your disposal to survive, whether it be magic, espionage, or charisma. With mysteries at every turn and threats encroaching upon you from all sides, it will be the bonds you create that determine whether you succeed or die.

Can you pierce the veil of carnage and deceit?

[From [url=https://konvel.itch.io/demons-of-the-hearth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一位战败后力量衰弱的魔王，渴望夺回王位，为怨恨深重、混乱不堪的族群争取一个光明的未来。为此，你来到桑克图斯——一座激情、暴力与背叛交织的城市。

为了生存，你必须用尽一切手段，无论是魔法、谍报，还是个人魅力。谜团无处不在，威胁从四面八方逼近；最终决定你成功还是丧命的，将是你与他人建立的羁绊。

你能穿透杀戮与欺骗织成的迷雾吗？

[摘自[url=https://konvel.itch.io/demons-of-the-hearth]itch.io[/url]]
